dedupe_keys.name: simulation data used in management ccl for ran slice performance improvement by subslicing

description: Marika Kulmar deposited training data and simulation results for management closed-control-loop decisions in radio access network slices. The TalTech description identifies a neural-network training folder used to decide whether to merge, split or retain subslices, an initialization-results folder and a runtime-results folder. The data support evaluation of subslicing decisions for improved network-slice performance, a telecommunications optimisation use. The repository dates the simulation results to 4 July through 27 October 2023 and links the study to IEEE Access article DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2024.3433475. That article is supporting documentation, not the dataset identity. The data are distributed as one public ZIP archive, listed at 11,782,573 bytes, under CC BY 4.0 without a stated charge. The archive contents were not opened. Internal file formats, column definitions, simulation timestep and geographic network extent remain unstated. This limitation affects immediate reuse until the provider's documentation is consulted. Update frequency is not stated. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
